https://gerberaprints.com/policies/shipp: All clothing items in our store are custom-made and require 1–3 business days for crafting and packing.
Embroidered hats are also made to order and typically require 1–3 business days for production and packing before shipment.
The shipping durations listed in the table below are relevant for regions such as the US, CA, AU, EU,...
Clothing Shipping option Production time Shipping time Standard shipping 1–3 business days 8–14 business days Fast shipping 6–8 business days Free shipping (orders $75+) 8–14 business days 2.
Embroidered hats - Furthermore, if your order is personalized and/or needs adjustment, it may take a few days for our designer to create a complete art file.
Design time will depend on adjustment (more or less, easy or difficult) can be from 1 - 2 days or more.
SHIPPING TIME - Please keep in mind the shipping time to the overseas states such as PR (Puerto Rico), HI (Hawaii), and AK (Alaska), QA (Qatar) will take 30 - 60 business days.
Please do not choose and pay for the Fast shipping option for this state.
https://gerberaprints.com/policies/refun: For additional info on our return, and refund policies see below!
RETURN We have a 30-day return policy, which means you have 30 days after receiving your item to request a return.
Accepted issues include: design errors, manufacturing defects, and incorrect items shipped (wrong product or wrong size).
For non-defective products, returns are only accepted when the product received does not match the product ordered due to an error on our part or our supplier’s part.
Defective items will be reshipped at no cost.
If the issue escalates and reship is not a suitable resolution, we may negotiate a partial or full refund on a case-by-case basis.
If the returned product arrives washed, worn, damaged, or without the original bag/box, it will not be eligible for reship or refund, and the item will be forfeited.
We reserve the right to accept or reject reship/refund requests that are not justified.
